items.title: Share Your Project Details
text: Send us photos of your concrete surface or structure via text or email, and we'll respond with a free, no-obligation quote for your demolition needs.

items.q: How much does concrete demolition cost?
a: Concrete demolition pricing varies based on project size, complexity, and specific requirements. Contact us for a free, no-obligation estimate tailored to your needs.

items.q: What areas do you serve for concrete demolition?
a: We serve the Greater Toronto Area, including Bradford, Port Perry, Pickering, Richmond Hill, Scarborough, Schomberg, Mississauga, and surrounding communities.

items.q: Do I need a permit for concrete removal?
Do you handle reinforced concrete demolition?
a: Yes, we specialize in reinforced concrete demolition with proper rebar extraction and disposal.
